description: Hook points fired by the agent-fsm cells (idle, think, wait, act); the loop points are in $AOS_HOME/lib/aos/apps/hook/loop_hooks.json. The agent family's rules (aos.agentlib.hooks, in code; this file only tells): exit 10 blocks a point with block true; on a point with output, exit 0 and a JSON object on stdout replace those keys; condition names the field a hookeds entry's condition is compared with (only for these tool names / error codes); a failing hook stops a point with block true and is one warning elsewhere.

before_queue.description: idle: a good letter is about to enter the conversation (/compact letters do not pass here)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

content.description: the text that will enter the conversation

output.description: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout: these keys replace the event's

before_queue.if_blocked: the letter is closed and dropped; mailbox_warning.txt says which hook dropped it

after_queue.description: idle: the letter is in history.jsonl and closed

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

before_tool.description: act: before each tool call runs (every tool)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

arguments.description: the parsed JSON arguments the tool will get

output.description: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout: these keys replace the event's

before_tool.subject: tool
before_tool.if_blocked: the tool does not run; the brain gets the hook's stdout (or a default line) as the tool result

after_tool.description: act: a tool finished, before its result enters history (not for a blocked tool)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

code.description: the tool's exit code, null when it timed out

output.description: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout: these keys replace the event's

after_tool.subject: tool

brain_failed.description: wait: asking the brain did not work

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

name.description: error code: LlmKernelMissing, SendFailed, BudgetMissing, BrainFailed or ReplyBad

error.description: the kernel's error object, when there is one (BudgetMissing, BrainFailed)

code.description: BrainFailed only, when the kernel's error has it: the kernel's code

status.description: BrainFailed only, when the kernel's error has it: the HTTP status

retry.description: BrainFailed only: true when the same request is sent again after a wait, false when the agent stops

attempt.description: BrainFailed only: failures in a row

wait_s.description: BrainFailed only, when retry is true: seconds until the next try

brain_failed.subject: code

tool_added.description: think: a tool name appeared in the tool box since the last request (the first look only remembers the names)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

tool_added.subject: tool

on_clock.description: start of every cell: the hook's clock moved on by its own every_cycles / every_ms (also once right after a start)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

first.description: true right after a start, a wake or a clock change

last_cycle.description: cycle of the last run, or null

config.description: the entry's config, when it has one
